page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture and deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 24 vCPUs mapped to 12 dedicated physical cores via hyper-threading. Cache resources include 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache. It incorporates vector instruction extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with hardware-accelerated AES cryptography.

System memory consists of 96.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not feature bundled local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators, necessitating reliance on network-attached block storage for persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included by default.

Benchmark evaluations indicate consistent mid-tier multi-threaded execution alongside constrained single-threaded performance. Single-core results register lower relative tiers across synthetic metrics, such as a Geekbench single-core score of 1008.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1107.98. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput achieves middle-tier ratings, demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core result of 17544.06, a Geekbench multi-core score of 7786.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 18227.84. Memory operations show robust uncached bandwidth, reaching 90.15 GB/sec for large block reads and 50.79 GB/sec for writes.

In operational benchmarks, the instance delivers steady mid-tier capability, achieving 16.81 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 13.07 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, and balanced software compilation via Clang (score of 14646.0). Given its hardware configuration, the server provides balanced compute density for horizontally scaled web services, microservices backends, continuous integration pipelines, and medium-scale caching or database applications that do not depend on low-latency single-thread execution.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance featuring 24 vCPUs and 12 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor, it includes 96.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance excludes integrated local storage and GPUs, relying instead on network block storage and providing an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data reflects moderate multi-core throughput, registering a PassMark CPU score of 18227.84 and handling 16.81 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-core metrics remain lower relative to modern architectures. Equipped with AVX-512 vector support and robust memory bandwidth, ecs.g5.6xlarge suits multi-threaded enterprise services, caching tiers, software compilation, and scalable web serving workloads.
